hints: Work out small piles by hand: 1, 2, 3 are wins; 4 is a loss; 5, 6, 7 are wins again.
A pile is losing exactly when the opponent can always return it to another losing pile.
Look for the repeating pattern in the pile size to get an O(1) rule.
